label.en: ● The 4 Forms of a Linear Equation — Interpretation & Quick-Graphing Rules
label.ar: ● The 4 Forms of a المعادلة الخطية — Interpretation & Quick-Graphing Rules

body.en:
Every non-vertical line in the \(xy\)-plane can be written in four standard SAT forms, each highlighting a specific geometric anchor for instant graphing:

  • 1. Slope–\(y\)-Intercept Form \(\big(y = mx + c\big)\): \(m = \frac{\Delta y}{\Delta x}\) is the constant rate of change (slope) and \((0, c)\) is the \(y\)-intercept (initial value at \(x = 0\)). Quick Graph: Plot \((0, c)\) on the \(y\)-axis, then move \(1\) unit right and \(m\) units vertically.
  • 2. Slope–\(x\)-Intercept (Root) Form \(\big(y = m(x - b)\big)\): \(m\) is the slope and \((b, 0)\) is the \(x\)-intercept (root/zero) where \(y = 0\) (and the \(y\)-intercept is \((0, -mb)\)). Quick Graph: Plot \((b, 0)\) directly on the \(x\)-axis, then step by slope \(m\) or connect to \((0, -mb)\).
  • 3. Double-Intercept Form \(\left(\dfrac{x}{a} + \dfrac{y}{b} = 1\right)\): \((a, 0)\) is the \(x\)-intercept and \((0, b)\) is the \(y\)-intercept, with implied slope \(m = -\dfrac{b}{a}\). Quick Graph: Mark \((a, 0)\) on the \(x\)-axis and \((0, b)\) on the \(y\)-axis and draw the line straight through them!
  • 4. General Form \(\big(ax + by + c = 0\big)\): Slope is \(m = -\dfrac{a}{b}\), \(x\)-intercept is \(\left(-\dfrac{c}{a}, 0\right)\), and \(y\)-intercept is \(\left(0, -\dfrac{c}{b}\right)\). Quick Graph (Cover-Up Method): Set \(y = 0 \implies x = -c/a\); set \(x = 0 \implies y = -c/b\); connect the two axis intercepts.
body.ar:
Every non-vertical line in the \(xy\)-plane can be written in four standard SAT forms, each highlighting a specific geometric anchor for instant graphing:

  • 1. الميل–\(y\)-المقطع Form \(\big(y = mx + c\big)\): \(m = \frac{\Delta y}{\Delta x}\) is the الثابت rate of change (الميل) and \((0, c)\) is the \(y\)-المقطع (initial value at \(x = 0\)). Quick التمثيل البياني: Plot \((0, c)\) on the \(y\)-axis, then move \(1\) unit right and \(m\) units vertically.
  • 2. الميل–\(x\)-المقطع (Root) Form \(\big(y = m(x - b)\big)\): \(m\) is the الميل and \((b, 0)\) is the \(x\)-المقطع (root/zero) حيث \(y = 0\) (and the \(y\)-المقطع is \((0, -mb)\)). Quick التمثيل البياني: Plot \((b, 0)\) directly on the \(x\)-axis, then step by الميل \(m\) or connect to \((0, -mb)\).
  • 3. Double-المقطع Form \(\left(\dfrac{x}{a} + \dfrac{y}{b} = 1\right)\): \((a, 0)\) is the \(x\)-المقطع and \((0, b)\) is the \(y\)-المقطع, with implied الميل \(m = -\dfrac{b}{a}\). Quick التمثيل البياني: Mark \((a, 0)\) on the \(x\)-axis and \((0, b)\) on the \(y\)-axis and draw the line straight through them!
  • 4. General Form \(\big(ax + by + c = 0\big)\): الميل is \(m = -\dfrac{a}{b}\), \(x\)-المقطع is \(\left(-\dfrac{c}{a}, 0\right)\), and \(y\)-المقطع is \(\left(0, -\dfrac{c}{b}\right)\). Quick التمثيل البياني (Cover-Up Method): Set \(y = 0 \implies x = -c/a\); set \(x = 0 \implies y = -c/b\); connect the two axis intercepts.

label.ar: ◆ لماذا تعمل هذه الطريقة رياضياً — First-Principles اشتقاق (المعادلات الخطية in One المتغير & Systems of المعادلات)

body.en:
Why Inscribed Angles Equal Half the Central Angle & Circle Completion Works: Given \(x^2 + y^2 + 2gx + 2fy + c = 0\), completing the square in \(x\) and \(y\) simultaneously yields:

\[ (x + g)^2 - g^2 + (y + f)^2 - f^2 + c = 0 \implies (x + g)^2 + (y + f)^2 = g^2 + f^2 - c \]

Thus the center is \((-g, -f)\) and the radius is \(r = \sqrt{g^2 + f^2 - c}\) (requiring \(g^2 + f^2 > c\)). In any circle, drawing diameter \(POQ\) splits an inscribed angle \(\angle APB\) into two isosceles triangles \(\triangle OAP\) and \(\triangle OBP\) (since \(OA = OB = OP = r\)); by the exterior angle theorem, \(\angle AOB = 2\angle APB\).
body.ar:
Why Inscribed Angles Equal Half the Central الزاوية & الدائرة Completion Works: المعطيات \(x^2 + y^2 + 2gx + 2fy + c = 0\), completing the square in \(x\) and \(y\) simultaneously yields:

\[ (x + g)^2 - g^2 + (y + f)^2 - f^2 + c = 0 \implies (x + g)^2 + (y + f)^2 = g^2 + f^2 - c \]

Thus the center is \((-g, -f)\) and the نصف القطر is \(r = \sqrt{g^2 + f^2 - c}\) (requiring \(g^2 + f^2 > c\)). In any الدائرة, drawing القطر \(POQ\) splits an inscribed الزاوية \(\angle APB\) into two isosceles triangles \(\triangle OAP\) and \(\triangle OBP\) (since \(OA = OB = OP = r\)); by the exterior الزاوية المبرهنة, \(\angle AOB = 2\angle APB\).

question.en:
Level 1 · Foundations

If \( 5(2x - 3) = 3(x + 4) + 6 \), what is the value of \( 7x - 15 \)?
question.ar:
Level 1 · Foundations

إذا كان \( 5(2x - 3) = 3(x + 4) + 6 \), ما قيمة \( 7x - 15 \)?

solution.en:
Expand both sides:

\[ 10x - 15 = 3x + 12 + 6 \implies 10x - 15 = 3x + 18. \]\[ 7x = 33 \implies x = \frac{33}{7}. \]

Substitute into the target expression \( 7x - 15 \):

\[ 7\left(\frac{33}{7}\right) - 15 = 33 - 15 = 18. \]
solution.ar:
فكّ المقدار both sides:

\[ 10x - 15 = 3x + 12 + 6 \implies 10x - 15 = 3x + 18. \]\[ 7x = 33 \implies x = \frac{33}{7}. \]

عوّض into the target expression \( 7x - 15 \):

\[ 7\left(\frac{33}{7}\right) - 15 = 33 - 15 = 18. \]

hints.en: Rewrite and simplify to obtain: \(7x = 33 \implies x\).
hints.ar: أعد كتابة العلاقة وبسّطها للحصول على: \(7x = 33 \implies x\).

body.en:
Solve the system: \[ \begin{cases} x + y = 10 \\ x - y = 2 \end{cases} \]

Add the equations together to eliminate \( y \): \[ 2x = 12 \implies x = 6. \]

Substitute into the first equation: \( 6 + y = 10 \implies y = 4 \). Solution is \( (6, 4) \).

Substitute into the first المعادلة: \( 6 + y = 10 \implies y = 4 \). الحل is \( (6, 4) \).

question.en:
Level 2 · Medium

A theater sold a total of 250 adult and student tickets for an evening performance, collecting \(2,400. If adult tickets cost \)12 each and student tickets cost \$2 each, how many student tickets were sold?
question.ar:
حل المسألة التالية في (Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations): Level 2 · Medium

A theater sold a total of 250 adult and student tickets for an evening performance, collecting \(2,400. If adult tickets cost \)12 each and student tickets cost \$2 each, how many student tickets were sold?

solution.en:
Let \( a \) be adult tickets and \( s \) be student tickets:

\[ \begin{cases} a + s = 250 \\ 12a + 8s = 2400 \end{cases} \]

Multiply the first equation by 12: \( 12a + 12s = 3000 \).

Subtract the second equation: \[ (12a + 12s) - (12a + 8s) = 3000 - 2400 \implies 4s = 600 \implies s = 150. \]

The theater sold 150 student tickets.

Subtract the second equation: \[ (12a + 12s) - (12a + 8s) = 3000 - 2400 \implies 4s = 600 \implies s = 150. \]

body.en: Analyze systems with parameters \( k \) and determine exact conditions for parallel lines (no solution) and coincident lines (infinite solutions).
body.ar: Analyze systems with المعاملات \( k \) and determine exact conditions for parallel lines (no الحل) and coincident lines (infinite الحلول).

label.en: ⚠️ SAT Traps & Pitfalls — Systems with Zero or Infinitely Many Solutions
label.ar: ⚠️ SAT Traps & Pitfalls — Systems with Zero or Infinitely Many الحلول

body.en:
• No Solution (Parallel Lines): Occurs when lines have the same slope but different \( y \)-intercepts (\( m_1 = m_2, b_1 \neq b_2 \)). In standard form \( \frac{a_1}{a_2} = \frac{b_1}{b_2} \neq \frac{c_1}{c_2} \).
  • Infinitely Many Solutions (Same Line): Occurs when the equations are scalar multiples: \( \frac{a_1}{a_2} = \frac{b_1}{b_2} = \frac{c_1}{c_2} \).
  • Distributing Negative Signs: In expressions like \( -(3x - 4) \), students often write \( -3x - 4 \) instead of \( -3x + 4 \).
  • Target Variable Trap: The SAT frequently asks for \( 2x - 1 \), \( x + y \), or \( y/x \) rather than \( x \). Never stop solving until you answer the specific expression requested!
body.ar:
• No الحل (Parallel Lines): Occurs عندما lines have the same slope but different \( y \)-intercepts (\( m_1 = m_2, b_1 \neq b_2 \)). In standard form \( \frac{a_1}{a_2} = \frac{b_1}{b_2} \neq \frac{c_1}{c_2} \).
  • Infinitely Many الحلول (Same Line): Occurs عندما the المعادلات are scalar multiples: \( \frac{a_1}{a_2} = \frac{b_1}{b_2} = \frac{c_1}{c_2} \).
  • Distributing Negative Signs: In expressions like \( -(3x - 4) \), students often write \( -3x - 4 \) instead of \( -3x + 4 \).
  • Target المتغير Trap: The SAT frequently asks for \( 2x - 1 \), \( x + y \), or \( y/x \) rather than \( x \). Never stop solving until you الإجابة the specific العبارة الجبرية requested!

body.en:
Problem: In the system below, for what value of constant \( k \) does the system have infinitely many solutions? \[ \begin{cases} 4x + 6y = 12 \\ 6x + ky = 18 \end{cases} \]

Solution: For infinitely many solutions, the ratio of all coefficients and constants must be equal: \[ \frac{4}{6} = \frac{6}{k} = \frac{12}{18}. \] Cross-multiply \( \frac{2}{3} = \frac{6}{k} \implies 2k = 18 \implies k = 9 \).
body.ar:
Problem: In the system below, for what value of الثابت \( k \) does the system have infinitely many الحلول? \[ \begin{cases} 4x + 6y = 12 \\ 6x + ky = 18 \end{cases} \]

Solution: For infinitely many الحلول, the ratio of all المعاملات and constants must be equal: \[ \frac{4}{6} = \frac{6}{k} = \frac{12}{18}. \] Cross-multiply \( \frac{2}{3} = \frac{6}{k} \implies 2k = 18 \implies k = 9 \).

question.en:
Level 3 · Advanced

In the system of equations below, \( k \) is a constant. For what value of \( k \) does the system have no solution? \[ \begin{cases} kx - 6y = 15 \\ 4x - 3y = 9 \end{cases} \]
question.ar:
حل المسألة التالية في (Linear Equations in One Variable & Systems of Equations): Level 3 · Advanced

In the system of equations below, \( k \) is a constant. For what value of \( k \) does the system have no solution? \[ \begin{cases} kx - 6y = 15 \\ 4x - 3y = 9 \end{cases} \]

solution.en:
For a system of two linear equations in standard form \( Ax + By = C \) to have no solution, the lines must be parallel (equal ratios of \( x \)- and \( y \)-coefficients, but unequal ratio of constants):

\[ \frac{k}{4} = \frac{-6}{-3} eq \frac{15}{9} \]\[ \frac{k}{4} = 2 \implies k = 8. \]

Check constant ratio: \( \frac{15}{9} = \frac{5}{3} eq 2 \), confirming the lines never intersect. Thus, \( k = 8 \).
solution.ar:

\[ \frac{k}{4} = \frac{-6}{-3} eq \frac{15}{9} \]\[ \frac{k}{4} = 2 \implies k = 8. \]

Check constant ratio: \( \frac{15}{9} = \frac{5}{3} eq 2 \), confirming the lines never intersect. وعليه، \( k = 8 \).

label.ar: Level 4 (Synthesis) — Symmetry & Block Elimination Shortcut (المعادلات الخطية في متغير واحد وأنظمة المعادلات الخطية)

body.en:
Problem: If \( 7x + 4y = 29 \) and \( 3x + 6y = 21 \), what is the value of \( x + y \)?

Solution: Instead of solving for \( x \) and \( y \) individually, add the two equations directly:

\[ (7x + 4y) + (3x + 6y) = 29 + 21 \implies 10x + 10y = 50. \]

Divide the entire equation by 10: \[ x + y = 5. \]
body.ar:
Problem: If \( 7x + 4y = 29 \) and \( 3x + 6y = 21 \), what is the value of \( x + y \)?

Solution: Instead of solving for \( x \) and \( y \) individually, add the two المعادلات directly:

\[ (7x + 4y) + (3x + 6y) = 29 + 21 \implies 10x + 10y = 50. \]

Divide the entire المعادلة by 10: \[ x + y = 5. \]

question.en:
Level 4 · Synthesis

In the system of equations \( ax + 8y = 24 \) and \( 6x + by = 8 \), \( a \) and \( b \) are constants. If the system has infinitely many solutions, what is the value of \( a + b \)?
question.ar:
Level 4 · Synthesis

In the system of equations \( ax + 8y = 24 \) and \( 6x + by = 8 \), \( a \) and \( b \) are constants. إذا كان the system has infinitely many solutions, ما قيمة \( a + b \)?

solution.en:
The constant ratio from the first equation to the second is \( \frac{24}{8} = 3 \). For infinitely many solutions, every coefficient in the first equation must be 3 times the corresponding coefficient in the second:

\[ a = 3 \times 6 = 18, \quad 8 = 3b \implies b = \frac{8}{3}. \]\[ a + b = 18 + \frac{8}{3} = \frac{62}{3}. \]
solution.ar:
خطوات الحل التفصيلية:

The constant ratio from the first equation to the second is \( \frac{24}{8} = 3 \). For infinitely many solutions, every coefficient in the first equation must be 3 times the corresponding coefficient in the second:

\[ a = 3 \times 6 = 18, \quad 8 = 3b \implies b = \frac{8}{3}. \]\[ a + b = 18 + \frac{8}{3} = \frac{62}{3}. \]

hints.en: The constant ratio from the first equation to the second is \( \frac{24}{8} = 3 \).
